texts.zh:
我们位于[from.solar_system.GetName]的行踪已被发现，[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国正以日益增长的怀疑监视着我们的一举一动。

经过紧张的外交交涉，他们要求我们离开他们的领土，否则将面临报复。
texts.en:
Our presence in [from.solar_system.GetName] has been detected, and the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire is monitoring our movements with growing suspicion.

Following tense diplomatic exchanges, they have demanded that we depart their territory or face the reprisals.

label.zh: 我们应该考虑继续前行。

texts.zh:
[from.solar_system.Owner.GetName]帝国位于[from.solar_system.GetName]星系的扫描仪并未发现我们的存在。

在隐形场保持激活期间，我们必须避免任何可能导致暴露行踪的行为。
texts.en:
The scanners of the [from.solar_system.Owner.GetName] empire in the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have not detected our presence.

While our cloaking field remains active, we must avoid any actions that could risk revealing our presence.

texts.zh:
跨越边境进入[from.solar_system.GetName]星系，我们未曾遭遇任何抵抗，唯有一种比任何扫描仪所能测量的还要深沉的紧张感。

这片空间昭示着有一个早已巅峰不再、却绝非手无寸铁的文明存在。倘若其注意力被吸引到我们身上，我们定会被发现力有不逮。

让审慎指引我们的每一步。这里并非我们的领地。
texts.en:
Crossing the border into the [from.solar_system.GetName] system, we encounter no resistance, only a tension deeper than any scan can measure.

This space bears the hallmarks of a civilization long past its zenith, yet far from powerless. Should its attention be drawn to us, we would be found wanting.

Let prudence guide our every move. This is not our domain.
